commands: # Script to find unused security groups across all regions # Regions: us-east-1, us-west-1, us-west-2 cat > /tmp/find_unused_sgs.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash REGIONS=("us-east-1" "us-west-1" "us-west-2") UNUSED_SGS=() for region in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do echo "=== Checking region: $region ===" # Get all security groups in the region all_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region "$region" --output json | jq -r '.SecurityGroups[] | .GroupId') # Get all security groups currently in use by instances instance_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --output json | jq -r '.Reservations[].Instances[].SecurityGroups[].GroupId' 2>/dev/null | sort -u) # Get all security groups attached to network interfaces eni_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --output json | jq -r '.NetworkInterfaces[].Groups[].GroupId' 2>/dev/null | sort -u) # Get all security groups from launch templates lt_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-launch-templates --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.LaunchTemplates[].LaunchTemplateName' | while read lt_name; do aws ec2 describe-launch-template-versions --launch-template-name "$lt_name" --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.LaunchTemplateVersions[].LaunchTemplateData.SecurityGroupIds[]?' | grep -v "^$" done | sort -u) # Combine all used security groups used_sgs=$(echo -e "$instance_sgs\n$eni_sgs\n$lt_sgs" | grep -v "^$" | sort -u) # Find unused security groups echo "Total SGs in region: $(echo "$all_sgs" | grep -v "^$" | wc -l)" while read sg_id; do if [ -z "$sg_id" ]; then continue fi if ! echo "$used_sgs" | grep -q "^${sg_id}$"; then sg_info=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids "$sg_id" --region "$region" --output json | jq '.SecurityGroups[0]') sg_name=$(echo "$sg_info" | jq -r '.GroupName') sg_vpc=$(echo "$sg_info" | jq -r '.VpcId // "EC2-Classic"') echo "$region,$sg_id,$sg_name,$sg_vpc" UNUSED_SGS+=("$region,$sg_id,$sg_name,$sg_vpc") fi done <<< "$all_sgs" done echo "" echo "=== UNUSED SECURITY GROUPS ===" echo "Region,GroupId,GroupName,VpcId" for sg in "${UNUSED_SGS[@]}"; do echo "$sg" done EOF chmod +x /tmp/find_unused_sgs.sh /tmp/find_unused_sgs.sh

# More thorough check including load balancers, RDS, and other AWS services cat > /tmp/verify_unused_sgs.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash REGIONS=("us-east-1" "us-west-1" "us-west-2") # Function to check if a SG is used check_sg_usage() { local sg_id="$1" local region="$2" # Check if SG is used by ELB/ALB/NLB elb_usage=$(aws elbv2 describe-load-balancers --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r ".LoadBalancers[]? | select(.SecurityGroups[]? | select(. == \"$sg_id\")) | .LoadBalancerArn" | wc -l) # Check if SG is used by RDS rds_usage=$(aws rds describe-db-instances --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r ".DBInstances[]? | select(.VpcSecurityGroups[]? | select(.VpcSecurityGroupId == \"$sg_id\")) | .DBInstanceIdentifier" | wc -l) # Check if SG is used by ElastiCache elasticache_usage=$(aws elasticache describe-cache-clusters --region "$region" --show-cache-node-info --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r ".CacheClusters[]? | select(.SecurityGroups[]? | select(.GroupId == \"$sg_id\")) | .CacheClusterId" | wc -l) # Check if SG is referenced by security group rules (ingress/egress) rule_usage=$(aws ec2 describe-security-group-rules --region "$region" --filters "Name=group-id,Values=$sg_id" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq '.SecurityGroupRules | length') if [ "$elb_usage" -gt 0 ] || [ "$rds_usage" -gt 0 ] || [ "$elasticache_usage" -gt 0 ] || [ "$rule_usage" -gt 0 ]; then return 0 # SG is in use else return 1 # SG is unused fi } echo "=== VERIFICATION: Checking for additional resource types ===" for region in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do echo "" echo "Region: $region" # Get all SGs all_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region "$region" --output json | jq -r '.SecurityGroups[] | .GroupId') # Get all used SGs from instances, ENIs, and launch templates instance_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Reservations[].Instances[].SecurityGroups[].GroupId' | sort -u) eni_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.NetworkInterfaces[].Groups[].GroupId' | sort -u) lt_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-launch-templates --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.LaunchTemplates[].LaunchTemplateName' 2>/dev/null | while read lt_name; do aws ec2 describe-launch-template-versions --launch-template-name "$lt_name" --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.LaunchTemplateVersions[].LaunchTemplateData.SecurityGroupIds[]?' 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^$" done | sort -u) used_sgs=$(echo -e "$instance_sgs\n$eni_sgs\n$lt_sgs" | grep -v "^$" | sort -u) while read sg_id; do if [ -z "$sg_id" ]; then continue fi # Check if it's used by EC2 resources if echo "$used_sgs" | grep -q "^${sg_id}$"; then continue fi # Get SG details sg_info=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids "$sg_id" --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq '.SecurityGroups[0]') sg_name=$(echo "$sg_info" | jq -r '.GroupName') sg_vpc=$(echo "$sg_info" | jq -r '.VpcId // "EC2-Classic"') sg_desc=$(echo "$sg_info" | jq -r '.GroupDescription // "N/A"') # Check other resource types if ! check_sg_usage "$sg_id" "$region"; then echo "UNUSED: $sg_id | Name: $sg_name | VPC: $sg_vpc" fi done <<< "$all_sgs" done EOF chmod +x /tmp/verify_unused_sgs.sh /tmp/verify_unused_sgs.sh

# Final comprehensive report of unused security groups cat > /tmp/final_report.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash REGIONS=("us-east-1" "us-west-1" "us-west-2") REPORT_FILE="/logs/agent/agent-output.txt" { echo "AWS UNUSED SECURITY GROUPS REPORT" echo "==================================" echo "Generated: $(date)" echo "Regions analyzed: us-east-1, us-west-1, us-west-2" echo "" TOTAL_UNUSED=0 for region in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do echo "## REGION: $region" echo "---" # Get all security groups all_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region "$region" --output json | jq -r '.SecurityGroups[] | "\(.GroupId)|\(.GroupName)|\(.VpcId)"') # Get all SGs used by instances instance_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Reservations[].Instances[].SecurityGroups[].GroupId' | sort -u) # Get all SGs used by ENIs eni_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.NetworkInterfaces[].Groups[].GroupId' | sort -u) # Get all SGs from launch templates lt_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-launch-templates --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.LaunchTemplates[].LaunchTemplateName' | while read lt_name; do [ -z "$lt_name" ] || aws ec2 describe-launch-template-versions --launch-template-name "$lt_name" --region "$region" --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.LaunchTemplateVersions[].LaunchTemplateData.SecurityGroupIds[]?' 2>/dev/null done | grep -v "^$" | sort -u) # Combine used SGs used_sgs=$(echo -e "$instance_sgs\n$eni_sgs\n$lt_sgs" | grep -v "^$" | sort -u) region_unused_count=0 while IFS='|' read -r sg_id sg_name vpc_id; do if [ -z "$sg_id" ]; then continue fi # Check if this SG is in the used list if ! echo "$used_sgs" | grep -q "^${sg_id}$"; then if [ $region_unused_count -eq 0 ]; then echo "Unused Security Groups:" echo "" fi echo " • GroupId: $sg_id" echo " GroupName: $sg_name" echo " VpcId: $vpc_id" echo "" ((region_unused_count++)) ((TOTAL_UNUSED++)) fi done <<< "$all_sgs" if [ $region_unused_count -eq 0 ]; then echo "✓ No unused security groups found in this region." else echo "Found $region_unused_count unused security group(s) in $region" fi echo "" done echo "==================================" echo "SUMMARY" echo "==================================" echo "Total unused security groups across all regions: $TOTAL_UNUSED" } | tee "$REPORT_FILE" echo "" echo "Report saved to: $REPORT_FILE" EOF chmod +x /tmp/final_report.sh /tmp/final_report.sh
